properties.description:
`init` puts the harness question to the person running it and generates MCP configuration for the harnesses they name, rather than for every harness reflow2 supports. `--harness=…` carries the same answer for non-interactive callers, and a run with no tty resolves without blocking rather than waiting on a prompt nobody can see.

Distinct from `cap:install-reaches-the-agent`, which is about the install reaching a harness that WILL read it — too little. This is the opposite failure: writing for harnesses nobody asked for. The two constrain the same generator from opposite sides, and neither subsumes the other.
properties.name: The install asks which harness, and writes only that one's files
